settings.aboutHeroTitle: About THE 2-DAY NATIONAL WORKSHOP ON THE ELECTRICITY ACT 2023
settings.aboutHeroSubtitle: The Electricity Act 2023 marks a historic milestone in Nigeria's power sector by empowering State Governments to establish, regulate and develop electricity markets within their jurisdictions. The Act creates significant opportunities to expand energy access, attract investment, stimulate industrial development and drive sustainable economic growth. Realising these opportunities, however, requires effective policy implementation, institutional preparedness and strong collaboration among governments, regulators, investors and development partners.

events.title: 2-Day National Workshop on the Electricity Act 2023 (As Amended)
events.description:
Workshop Concept and Objectives:
- Deep dive into the decentralisation and autonomy provisions of the Electricity Act 2023, with a strong focus on helping each State understand that they now have full autonomy on electricity matters within their jurisdiction by virtue of the law.
- Educate, enlighten, and teach participants on the practical implications of the Act for electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and regulation at the state level.
- Provide clear guidance on how States can establish and implement their own electricity markets, regulatory frameworks, and infrastructure development strategies using the full autonomy granted by the Electricity Act 2023 (as amended).
- Facilitate knowledge exchange on the provisions of the Act, regulatory alignment, and the practical steps required for States to fully exercise their autonomy on electricity matters.
events.content:
Deep dive into the decentralisation and autonomy provisions of the Electricity Act 2023, with a strong focus on helping each State understand that they now have full autonomy on electricity matters within their jurisdiction by virtue of the law.

Educate, enlighten, and teach participants on the practical implications of the Act for electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and regulation at the state level.

Provide clear guidance on how States can establish and implement their own electricity markets, regulatory frameworks, and infrastructure development strategies using the full autonomy granted by the Electricity Act 2023 (as amended).

Facilitate knowledge exchange on the provisions of the Act, regulatory alignment, and the practical steps required for States to fully exercise their autonomy on electricity matters.
